dict.Ambalajele circulă cu avizul de însoțire: Packaging travels with the delivery note; the deposit is invoiced or deducted on return, as agreed with the partner.
dict.Ambalajele cu marfă primită se trec și î: Packaging that comes with received goods also goes in Sheets → Goods receipt note; packaging given to customers, on the delivery note.
dict.Paleții, navetele, lăzile și buteliile p: Pallets, plastic crates, crates and cylinders received from partners or given to them, with the delivery note and the deposit per piece: each partner's balance on each kind of packaging is calculated automatically (to give back in yellow, to get back in red, closed in green), and on the right you get the balances by kind of packaging, the deposit in lei and the balance of a chosen partner.
dict.Soldul pozitiv înseamnă ambalaje ale par: A positive balance means the partner's packaging is with us (to give back); a negative one, our packaging is with them (to get back).
dict.Către un client sau un furnizor: câți pa: To a customer or a supplier: how many pallets, plastic crates or crates of each are with the other at a date, with their deposit, and the request to confirm or object within a term, then how the return or settlement is made
